WITH inserted_acc AS (
  INSERT INTO cdp.client_accounts (company_name, domain, status)
  SELECT {{ $json.sql_company ? "'" + $json.sql_company + "'" : 'NULL' }}, {{ $json.sql_domain ? "'" + $json.sql_domain + "'" : 'NULL' }}, 'prospect'
  WHERE {{ $json.sql_company ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }}
  ON CONFLICT (domain) DO UPDATE SET company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name
  RETURNING id
),
inserted_person AS (
  INSERT INTO cdp.persons (first_name, last_name, primary_email, linkedin_url, status)
  VALUES (
    {{ $json.sql_first_name ? "'" + $json.sql_first_name + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.sql_last_name ? "'" + $json.sql_last_name + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.sql_email ? "'" + $json.sql_email + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.sql_profile_url ? "'" + $json.sql_profile_url + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    'active'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (primary_email) WHERE primary_email IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET
    first_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.first_name, cdp.persons.first_name),
    last_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_name, cdp.persons.last_name),
    linkedin_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.linkedin_url, cdp.persons.linkedin_url)
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO cdp.leads (source, source_lead_id, first_name, last_name, email, company_name, job_title, linkedin_url, person_id, status)

  '{{ $json.source }}',
  {{ $json.sql_connection_id ? "'" + $json.sql_connection_id + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.sql_first_name ? "'" + $json.sql_first_name + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.sql_last_name ? "'" + $json.sql_last_name + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.sql_email ? "'" + $json.sql_email + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.sql_company ? "'" + $json.sql_company + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.sql_position ? "'" + $json.sql_position + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.sql_profile_url ? "'" + $json.sql_profile_url + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM inserted_person), (SELECT id FROM cdp.persons WHERE linkedin_url = '{{ $json.sql_profile_url }}' LIMIT 1)),
  'processed';
